nodes.description: Address with governance rights over airdrop creation and recycling.
Monotonic counter of airdrop ids, initialized to MIN_ID (1e4).
Mapping id => Airdrop struct storing token, merkle root, amounts and claim bitmap.
Mapping token => amount reserved for active or pending airdrops.
Initializer that sets _idTracker to MIN_ID and governance to the caller.
Owner-only function updating the governance address.
Governance-only creation of a new airdrop with merkle root, deadline, amount and count.
Claims an airdrop share after merkle proof verification and transfers tokens.
Governance-only recovery of unclaimed tokens after airdrop expiry.
External view returning the unreserved token balance of the contract.
External view returning the unclaimed amount for a valid airdrop id.
External view reporting expiry state of an airdrop id.
External view reporting whether a given index was claimed.
External view reporting whether all entries of an airdrop were claimed.
Internal helper computing token balance minus assigned balances.
Internal helper returning amount minus claimedAmount for an airdrop.
Internal helper checking id >= MIN_ID and id < _idTracker.
Internal helper comparing airdrop deadline with current timestamp.
Internal helper reading the claimed bitmap word and mask for an index.
Internal helper comparing claimedCount with count for an airdrop.
Internal helper returning block.timestamp.
UUPS authorization hook, restricted to the owner via onlyOwner.
UUPS external upgrade entrypoint guarded by onlyProxy.
UUPS payable upgrade entrypoint that also performs a delegatecall with data.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership and governance checks.
Miner-influenced timestamp used for deadline and expiry logic.
External ERC20 token transfer in claim executed before balance bookkeeping completes.
External ERC20 token transfer in recycle sending unclaimed tokens to recipient.
Low-level delegatecall to an arbitrary implementation address inside ERC1967 upgrade logic.
New governance address argument of setGovernance.

edges.reason: initialize assigns governance from _msgSender(), i.e. caller-controlled msg.sender.
setGovernance is gated by the onlyOwner modifier which compares owner() to _msgSender().
create is gated by onlyGovernance which compares _msgSender() to governance.
recycle is gated by onlyGovernance which compares _msgSender() to governance.
_authorizeUpgrade is empty but restricted by onlyOwner, relying on msg.sender ownership.
_getTimestamp returns block.timestamp, an externally influenced value.
create validates deadline against the current timestamp.
_isExpired compares the airdrop deadline against the current timestamp.
claim requires the airdrop to not be expired, gating on timestamp.
recycle requires the airdrop to be expired, gating on timestamp.
create reads _idTracker into the local id variable.
create mutates _idTracker through the post-increment of the airdrop id.
The new id indexes the _airdrops mapping when the Airdrop struct is created.
The token argument is stored into the new Airdrop struct.
The amount argument is stored into the new Airdrop struct.
The merkleRoot argument is stored into the new Airdrop struct.
The deadline argument is stored into the new Airdrop struct.
The count argument is stored into the new Airdrop struct.
The token argument keys the _assignedBalances increment in create.
The amount argument increases the reserved balance for the token.
create enforces available balance by calling _availableBalance.
_availableBalance subtracts _assignedBalances from the token balance.
claim loads the Airdrop storage pointer for the given id.
The airdrop storage pointer inside claim resolves to the _airdrops mapping entry.
The claim id argument is validated through _isValid.
The onlyValid modifier gates claim execution on id validity.
claim performs an external token transfer via safeTransfer, yielding control to the token contract.
The claim account argument is the recipient of the external token transfer.
The claim amount argument is the value of the external token transfer.
After transferring, claim decrements the _assignedBalances entry for the token.
The claim index argument feeds the bitmap check in _isClaimed.
claim reverts when _isClaimed reports the index was already claimed.
The merkle proof argument is used with the computed leaf hash.
The computed leaf hash is verified against the stored merkleRoot.
claim reduces the assigned balance bookkeeping for the transferred token.
recycle computes the unclaimed amount into a local variable.
The computed unclaimed amount is forwarded to the external token transfer.
The recycle recipient argument receives the external token transfer.
recycle decrements the _assignedBalances entry after transferring.
The recycle id argument is validated through _isValid.
upgradeTo reaches _functionDelegateCall through _upgradeToAndCallSecure, executing arbitrary delegatecall.
upgradeToAndCall delegates arbitrary calldata to the new implementation.
upgradeTo invokes _authorizeUpgrade before changing the implementation.
upgradeToAndCall invokes _authorizeUpgrade before changing the implementation.
The external availableBalance view wraps the internal _availableBalance helper.
getUnclaimed delegates to _getUnclaimed for valid ids.
_getUnclaimed reads amount and claimedAmount from the _airdrops entry.
isExpired delegates to the internal _isExpired helper.
isClaimed delegates to the internal _isClaimed bitmap helper.
isAllClaimed delegates to the internal _isAllClaimed helper.
_isClaimed reads the claimedBitMap word from the _airdrops entry.
_isAllClaimed reads claimedCount and count from the _airdrops entry.
_isValid compares the id against the _idTracker upper bound.
The _airdrops mapping supplies the values read by _getUnclaimed.
The _airdrops mapping supplies the deadline read by _isExpired.
create returns the locally generated airdrop id.
The ERC20 transfer gives the token contract control flow that can re-enter claim before bookkeeping settles.
The ERC20 transfer gives the token contract control flow that can re-enter recycle before bookkeeping settles.

normalization_plan.reason: The governance_ parameter only exists to assign the governance state variable inside setGovernance.
The token parameter is consumed solely by create to populate the Airdrop struct and assigned balance.
The deadline parameter is only used by create to timestamp a new airdrop.
The amount parameter is only used by create to size the new airdrop.
The merkleRoot parameter is only stored by create.
The count parameter is only stored by create.
The returned airdrop id is a create-local value.
The index parameter is only meaningful inside claim bitmap bookkeeping.
The account parameter is only used inside claim to route the transfer.
The amount parameter directly feeds the external token transfer in claim.
The merkleProof parameter is only used inside claim proof verification.
The id parameter is only used inside claim validation and lookup.
The recipient parameter directly feeds the external token transfer in recycle.
The id parameter is only used inside recycle validation and lookup.
The local id variable is an intermediate assignment inside create.
The airdrop storage pointer is a claim-local reference into _airdrops.
The node leaf hash is a claim-local computation.
The unclaimed amount local is an intermediate computation inside recycle.
